# Load libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(vegan)
library(nationalparkcolors)
```

# Load data

```{r}
esviritu_human <- fread(here("data", "Human_data.tsv"))

sample_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata[!apply(sample_metadata, 1, function(row) all(is.na(row))), ]

sample_metadata <- sample_metadata %>%
  filter(!grepl("SET", sample_ID)) %>%
  mutate(Year_cat = ifelse(grepl("^(2020|2021)", sample_ID), 
                          "2020-2021", "2024-2025"))
```

```{r}
esviritu_human_ANI90 <- esviritu_human %>%
  filter(avg_read_identity >=0.90)
```

## Function for RPKMF value calculation (at taxa level)

```{r}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_ID, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(RPKMF)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  #tidyr
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_ID,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```

## PERMANOVA on Bray-Curtis distance

```{r}

bray_curtis_human <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(vegdist(t(RPKMF_df(esviritu_human, "species")[,-1]))), method="bray")
bray_curtis_human_ANI90 <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(vegdist(t(RPKMF_df(esviritu_human_ANI90, "species")[,-1]))), method="bray")
```
Test the significance of city in the whole dataset

```{r}
set.seed(2025)

permanova_bc_human <- adonis2(bray_curtis_human ~ City, data=sample_metadata,
                              permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human
round(p.adjust(permanova_bc_human$`Pr(>F)`, "BH"),6)
```
```{r}
set.seed(2025)
permanova_bc_human_ANI90 <- adonis2(bray_curtis_human_ANI90 ~ City, data=sample_metadata,
                                    permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_ANI90
```


Test the significance of city in separate datasets (for each year)

```{r}
bc_20_21 <- bray_curtis_human[1:60,1:60]
bc_20_21_ANI90 <- bray_curtis_human_ANI90[1:60,1:60]


bc_24_25 <- bray_curtis_human[61:120, 61:120]
bc_24_25_ANI90 <- bray_curtis_human_ANI90[61:120, 61:120]
```

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
permanova_bc_human_20_21 <- adonis2(bc_20_21 ~ City, data=sample_metadata[1:60,],
                                    permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_20_21

permanova_bc_human_20_21_ANI90 <- adonis2(bc_20_21_ANI90 ~ City, data=sample_metadata[1:60,],
                                          permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_20_21_ANI90
```

```{r}
permanova_bc_human_24_25 <- adonis2(bc_24_25 ~ City, data=sample_metadata[61:120,],
                              permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_24_25

permanova_bc_human_24_25_ANI90 <- adonis2(bc_24_25_ANI90 ~ City, data=sample_metadata[61:120,],
                              permutations=9999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_24_25_ANI90
```

## PCoA plot on Bray-Curtis distance

```{r PCoA-Bray-Curtis}
set.seed(2025)

plot_PCoA <- function(data, taxa_level, annot_col, annot_shape){

  #calculate RPKMF df (cols species, rows samples)
  RPKMF_df <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  
  bray_curtis <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(vegdist(t(RPKMF_df[,-1]))), method="bray")
  
  bray_curtis$sample_ID1 <- rownames(bray_curtis)

  #return(bray_curtis)
  
  pcoa <- cmdscale(bray_curtis[,-ncol(bray_curtis)], eig=TRUE)
  pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
  pcoa_df$sample_ID <- bray_curtis$sample_ID1

  pcoa_df_meta <- merge(pcoa_df, sample_metadata, by="sample_ID")
  
  #explained variance by PC 
  exp_var <- pcoa$eig /(sum(pcoa$eig))
  PC1_var <- round(exp_var[1]*100, 2)
  PC2_var <- round(exp_var[2]*100, 2)

  
  plot <- ggplot(pcoa_df_meta, aes(x = V1, y = V2, color=.data[[annot_col]],shape=.data[[annot_shape]])) +
  geom_point(size=4) +
  labs(x=sprintf("PCoA-1 (%s %%)", PC1_var), 
       y= sprintf("PCoA-2 (%s %%)", PC2_var), 
       title="PCoA Ordination") +
    #stat_ellipse(.data[[annot_col]]) +
  scale_color_manual(values=park_palette("DeathValley")[c(1,2,4,5,6)],
                     name="City") +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 16), name="Year") +
  theme_bw()
  
  return(plot)
}

```


```{r}
beta_PCoA_human <- plot_PCoA(data=esviritu_human, taxa_level="species", 
          annot_col = "City", annot_shape = "Year_cat") + fonts

ggsave(beta_PCoA_human, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Diversity_metrics","beta_PCoA_human.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)

beta_PCoA_human_ANI90 <- plot_PCoA(data=esviritu_human_ANI90, taxa_level="species", 
          annot_col = "City", annot_shape = "Year_cat") + fonts

ggsave(beta_PCoA_human_ANI90, 
       file = here("outputs/Figures/Diversity_metrics","beta_PCoA_human_ANI90.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
